Player Movement

Player-specific movement with dash and dodge abilities.

Component Mob

Schema

JSON
{
  "playerMovement": {}
}

Description

The Player Movement component extends base movement with player-specific abilities such as dashing and dodging. It provides enhanced movement mechanics designed for player-controlled entities.

Fields

FieldTypeDescription
Inherits base movement properties. Player-specific abilities are configured through the control handler.

Example

JSON
{
  "playerMovement": {}
}
